name: Can rainwater damage cause mold, and how quickly does it appear?

mainEntity.name: Can rainwater damage cause mold, and how quickly does it appear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, rainwater damage is a primary cause of mold growth in homes. Mold can start to appear within 24 to 48 hours of water intrusion, especially in warm, humid conditions. It thrives in damp environments and feeds on organic materials like wood, drywall, and fabrics. If not addressed promptly, mold can spread rapidly, causing structural damage and potentially affecting indoor air quality. Professional water damage restoration includes thorough drying and often antimicrobial treatments to prevent or mitigate mold issues.
